method.flux: Nova total poloidal flux [Wb]; fixed amplitude, constant gauge removed
method.census: Existing census._critical_points with 16x,32x,64x refinement until the polished point set and gradient winding close at two successive refinements; measure.polish is the only root owner; Hessian eigenvalues distinguish maxima/minima/saddles
method.plasma_qualification: Solved points inside the closed 99.9% main-plasma contour containing the current centroid; EFIT points inside its own labelled LCFS; saved support membership retained separately
method.axis: Only one in-plasma maximum and zero minima admits an axis; otherwise axis_rz_m, axis_offset_cm and rigid_shift_residual_cm are null
method.translation: applied displacement: aligned(R,Z)=solved(R-dR,Z-dZ); no axis seed enters the fit
method.verdict: rigid iff >=50% squared mismatch removed AND remaining lower-X distance <=50% initial; local otherwise. This is non-rigid, not a claim of separatrix-only localisation
method.core_flatness: 5th-to-95th-percentile flux variation on a 60 cm vertical cut, at mean R of all main-plasma maxima and centred at the map-current centroid Z. Ratio to EFIT; smaller is flatter
method.current_density_check: Public native Ampere stencil; median centre |dZ|<=0.10 m versus shoulders 0.15<=|dZ|<=0.35 m, within 1.6 radial grid steps of the same cut R. Continuous spline curvature at the middle is a companion check
method.current: Native-stencil Ampere current on saved support and, separately, on the closed main-plasma contour; EFIT on labelled LCFS; no amplitude renormalisation or negative clipping
method.force: Own-field integral j_phi cross B_p with 2*pi*R*dA; radial scalar hoop loading; not pressure-subtracted total force balance
method.boundary: Signed inboard/outboard R gaps at EFIT stored axis height and signed top Z gap, using solved 99.9% surface against labelled LCFS; lower X is Euclidean gap of qualified nulls
method.resolution: Saved 33x33 fields; refined reads interpolate these maps and are not additional physical resolution or forward solves
